meta.name: pol-probe
meta.description: Define a Proof of Life probe to test a risky hypothesis cheaply. Use when you need harsh truth before building real product.

copy.tagline: 用低成本探针验证高风险假设
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在投入开发前快速验证产品想法是否靠谱
copy.tagline_en: Validate risky hypotheses with low-cost probes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly test product ideas before building

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你设计一个轻量级、用完即弃的验证实验（Proof of Life probe），用来快速测试一个高风险假设，避免直接开发正式产品。它会引导你定义假设、选择原型类型、设定成功标准，并规划销毁方案。
howto.when: 当你需要验证一个具体假设或消除某个风险，但又不想投入大量开发资源时触发。例如，在构思新功能或定价方案前，想低成本测试可行性。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 PoL probe，测试餐厅老板是否会每天拍照上传发票。
say.note: Claude 会引导你定义假设、原型类型和成功标准。

say.text: 写一个 PoL probe，验证用户能否区分“归档”和“删除”。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude helps you design a lightweight, disposable validation experiment (Proof of Life probe) to quickly test a risky hypothesis without building production software. It guides you to define the hypothesis, choose a prototype type, set success criteria, and plan disposal.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to validate a specific hypothesis or eliminate a risk without heavy development investment. For example, before building a new feature or pricing model, to test feasibility cheaply.

say_en.text: Design a PoL probe to test if restaurant managers will photograph invoices daily.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through hypothesis, prototype type, and success criteria.

say_en.text: Write a PoL probe to verify users can distinguish 'archive' from 'delete'.
